base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y -qq protobuf-compiler libprotobuf-dev libtss2-dev libssl-dev pkg-config git curl ca-certificates build-essential cmake clang llvm
setup_runtime_commands: cd /workspace && cargo fetch -p verifier --features se-verifier || true

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: cargo uses Cargo.lock for deterministic builds; no additional test-only deps needed
runtime_profile.notes: Rust toolchain installed via rustup with stable channel. System dependencies include protobuf-compiler, libprotobuf-dev, libtss2-dev, libssl-dev for se-verifier feature. Git and curl included in baseline packages.

notes: Base image: rust:slim provides Rust toolchain but we install via rustup for flexibility. System packages include git and curl (baseline) plus protobuf-compiler, libprotobuf-dev, libtss2-dev, libssl-dev, pkg-config for building verifier with se-verifier feature. The se-verifier feature requires OpenSSL for certificate handling. The environment supports building and testing the IBM SE verifier on x86_64 (development) though target deployment is s390x.
